statement: theorem without_feasibility : let loss : ℕ → Bool → ℝ := fun t b => if b then if t = 0 then -10 else 5 else 0 let leader : ℕ → Bool := fun n => n = 2 let V : Set Bool := {false} (∀ n, 0 < n → n ≤ 2 → ∀ u ∈ V, (∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, loss t (leader n)) ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, loss t u) ∧ leader 2 ∉ V ∧ (∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, loss t (leader (t + 1))) > ∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, loss t (leader 2)
